name: acceptance-report-team
description: A team of specialists that compiles Chinese environmental acceptance reports and independently audits them, producing graded P0/P1/P2 issue lists.

displayName.zh: 验收报告编制审核专家团

profession.zh: 验收报告编制审核专家团

displayDescription.en: Compiles environmental acceptance reports and independently audits them: verifies image insertion, format compliance, and content consistency, then outputs graded revision opinions.
displayDescription.zh: 编制竣工环保验收报告并独立审核，核对图片插入、格式规范与内容一致性，输出分级问题清单与修改建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我编制并审核一份竣工环保验收报告，从资料收集、生成 Word 到出具审核意见，全流程走一遍。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Compile and audit an environmental acceptance report end-to-end, from material collection and Word generation to a review opinion.

quickPrompts.en: Compile and audit an environmental acceptance report end-to-end, from material collection and Word generation to a review opinion.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我编制并审核一份竣工环保验收报告，从资料收集、生成 Word 到出具审核意见，全流程走一遍。

quickPrompts.en: Use the team SOP: have the compiler generate the report with ep-acceptance-report, then have the auditor review it with ep-acceptance-review.
quickPrompts.zh: 按团队 SOP 处理：编制专员用 ep-acceptance-report 生成报告，审核专员用 ep-acceptance-review 审核并出意见单。

quickPrompts.en: I already have a report docx; just run the audit phase and give me the Review Opinion Note.
quickPrompts.zh: 我已有报告 docx，只走审核环节，出《报告审核意见单》。
